audit.whatIsWrong: Two fabricated mechanics ran through the whole page. (1) 'Her passive shreds your armor' appears in whys[2], whys[3], spikes[2], mid, late and wants.foe[1] — Ionian Fervor is stacking bonus attack speed plus bonus on-hit damage at max stacks. It shreds nothing. (2) Defiant Dance is called a 'damage-reduction-and-heal' in wants.you[0], mid and elsewhere — Riot's text gives reduced PHYSICAL damage during the charge only. The heal in her kit is on Bladesurge (Q).
audit.why: A player who believes his armor is being shredded builds and trades completely differently, and one who expects her W to heal will mistime the bait. Both claims are absent from Riot's text.
audit.corrected: Every armor-shred line replaced with Ionian Fervor's real effect (attack-speed stacks out-pacing your True Grit), and Defiant Dance restated as physical damage reduction on the charge with the heal moved to Bladesurge, where it belongs.

audit.whatIsWrong: Four rows contradicted their own whys: win[0] said Graves though whys[0] says 'neither side wins the opener'; win[1] said Skill though whys[1] gives her the window; win[4] said Graves though whys[4] calls 6 'your one genuinely even window'; win[5] said Irelia though whys[5] calls first item your spike. Packet chart is Skill, Irelia, Irelia, Irelia, Skill, Graves, Irelia.
audit.why: The prose was right in all four cases and the sides were wrong.
audit.corrected: Chart flipped as one atomic group to Skill, Irelia, Irelia, Irelia, Skill, Graves, Irelia with matching ratings and four rewritten phase whys.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 was written as a Graves spike and first item as hers — the reverse of the page's own text. The real timers: Collateral Damage 100/80/60s, Defiant Dance 20/18/16/14/12s, Vanguard's Edge 125/105/85s.
audit.why: Your R only converts when her W is down; that pairing is what makes 6 even and first item yours.
audit.corrected: phases[4] and phases[5] restated with Defiant Dance's 20s rank-1 timer as the concrete commit trigger.

audit.whatIsWrong: wants.you[1] told you to 'blind her empowered Bladesurge autos' with Smoke Screen, and report[10] repeats the blind claim. The W has no blind — reduced sight range, impact magic damage, brief slow.
audit.why: Her autos land through the cloud; what actually helps is that she loses sight of you and of reset targets.
audit.corrected: Both restated. Also noting the kit file's derived 'grounding' flag on Flawless Duet contradicts Riot's text (damage, stun, Mark) — this page does not claim her E denies Quickdraw, and should not.

edits.before: Four shells of buckshot win any level-1 face-off — trade autos point-blank where every pellet lands.

edits.before: E online — dash-reload weaving starts: auto, E for the grit armor and reset, auto again. Most champs lose this flat.
edits.after: Her E stun and second Bladesurge charge land before your kit assembles — she dances in and out of shell range.

edits.before: Collateral Damage adds an execute and a disengage knockback in one — hold it for either, never for chip.

edits.after: Fully online, her Flawless Duet stun locks you before you can E out, and Ionian Fervor's stacking attack speed out-paces the True Grit armor you rely on.

edits.before: In extended trades her passive armor shred cancels your stacking and her Defiant Dance blocks your burst front-load, so the longer the fight the worse your math.
edits.after: In extended trades Ionian Fervor's attack speed out-paces your armor stacking and Defiant Dance blocks the front-load of your burst, so the longer the fight the worse your math.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 are her playground: her passive stacks shred your armor and directly cancel the True Grit stacking your whole kit leans on, so the longer the trade the worse your math gets, and her W (Defiant Dance) blocks the front-load of your auto+Q burst while healing her back. Your one real swing is 6 — Collateral Damage is a nuke she can't Bladesurge out of if you catch her with Defiant Dance down. Bait the block: throw a Q to make her pop W early, E in, blind her with Smoke Screen, and R her once Defiant Dance is on cooldown. If her W is up, do not commit — she'll halve the R and heal the rest.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 are her playground: Ionian Fervor stacks attack speed faster than True Grit stacks armor, so the longer the trade the worse your math gets, and her W (Defiant Dance) cuts the physical front-load of your auto+Q burst while every Bladesurge heals her back. Your one real swing is 6 — Collateral Damage is a nuke she can't Bladesurge out of if you catch her with Defiant Dance down. Bait the block: throw a Q to make her pop W early, E in, fog her with Smoke Screen, and R her inside that 20s window. If her W is up, do not commit.

edits.before: This is where it slips fully out of reach. A fed Irelia Q-dances through your 4-shell spread so most of your point-blank DPS misses, her passive stacks shred the armor your whole kit is built around, and Defiant Dance blocks the exact R-into-burst combo that is your only kill pattern. You don't out-scale her — she resets off minions, halves your burst, and shreds everything you stack. Your only path is a lead banked from a 6 or first-item kill, ending before she has two items; if it goes long, ask for ganks and split away rather than dueling, because the straight 1v1 is lost.
edits.after: This is where it slips fully out of reach. A fed Irelia Q-dances through your 4-shell spread so most of your point-blank DPS misses, Ionian Fervor's attack-speed stacks out-pace the armor your kit is built around, and Defiant Dance blocks the exact R-into-burst combo that is your only kill pattern. You don't out-scale her — she resets off minions, heals through Bladesurge, and blunts your burst. Your path is a lead banked from a 6 or first-item kill, closed before she has two items; if it runs long, ask for ganks and split rather than duel.

edits.before: Your W smoke blinds tower dives and breaks gank pathing — drop it on arrival and turn their 2v1 into a coin flip you win.
edits.after: Smoke Screen cuts sight and slows on impact — no blind. Drop it as the gank arrives and fight them blind-sided in the fog.
